title: cordiera hexagyna
intro: Cordiera hexagyna, commonly known as Cordia, is a plant species belonging to the Borreria genus of the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe various ailments such as digestive issues and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cordiera hexagyna include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and act as a diuretic. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
